provenance: Verbatim from Table 1 of Wu et al. 2024 'Inference Scaling Laws: An Empirical Analysis of Compute-Optimal Inference' (MATH500; weighted voting aggregates candidates for both strategies): Mistral-7B sampling@256 42.8% at 8.70e14 FLOPs vs REBASE@32 45.0% at 1.36e14; Llemma-7B sampling@256 45.5% at 10.0e14 vs REBASE@32 46.8% at 1.48e14; Llemma-34B sampling@64 46.7% at 12.1e14 vs REBASE@32 49.2% at 7.08e14. x = inference FLOPs in units of 1e14; y = MATH500 accuracy (%); points are ordered as the sampling/REBASE pair per model, matching fit.params.
